name: Podcast Interview Guide
description: Produces a podcast interview guide with rapport-building openers, primary topic questions with follow-up probes, lightning round questions, and a closing sequence. Includes active listening cues and redirect language. Use when the user asks to prepare interview questions for a podcast guest, plan a podcast interview, or create a question flow for a conversation. Do NOT use for full episode planning with segments and timing (use podcast-episode-planning), audio production settings (use audio-editing-guide), or non-podcast interview preparation (use interview-prep).
